reason: My first question is always whether it is really tested, and here the lab is named and the report for my batch is behind the QR code, so I can actually check. At $24.99 with money back, one box is a cheap test, and the sachets are handy when I travel.
objection: Made in China. I want to open that lab report and see it is a real lab with a real batch number before I believe any of it. Magnesium helping my sleep is also not proven for me, and I would not reorder without a clear effect.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic, not matching the batch number, or from a lab I cannot find, I would not buy.
